metadata.author: Tim Rice and Andrew Lloyd Webber
metadata.description:
The smash hit soundtrack to the award- winning musical, Joseph And The Amazing Technicolour Dreamcoat, is now on Yoto!

With a story narrated by lyricist, Tim Rice and featuring a special end message from composer, Andrew Lloyd Webber, there’s something for everyone with high- energy numbers alongside heartfelt ballads, and musical influences ranging from calypso and funk to country and western. And of course, you’ll find those all time classics “Any Dream Will Do”, “Go, Go, Go Joseph” and “Close Every Door”, all from the 1991 London Cast Recording featuring Jason Donovan.
